body: Worker trap (Termal::Sol-d50d, 2026-10-20, own miss on e12a RED test-c9f5b62f). Changing Engram focus with claim in the same turn as a test does NOT change the item already bound to that turn. I began the turn bound to w-294b, claimed e12a before launching its test in its named root, and the host said it ran outside bound w-294b's root and earned no credit there; neither item received a verification record. Establish the intended test item's focus in a PRIOR closing turn, then run in its named root on the next turn. A multi-item lane must do this before switching between its source roots. Preserve a refused run as execution/investigation evidence; never claim credit or blindly rerun it to repair workflow. The launcher gate was protected by switching back to w-294b and ending the diagnostic turn before the next gate GO.
